from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3,time,sys,json

root=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
dbp=root/"models/runtime.sqlite"
task_id="A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-20261007-R4"

if not dbp.exists() or dbp.is_symlink():
    print("E122=RUNTIME_DB_MISSING",flush=True); raise SystemExit(31)

db=sqlite3.connect("file:"+str(dbp)+"?mode=ro",uri=True)
try:
    task=db.execute("select status,attempt,run from tasks where id=?",(task_id,)).fetchone()
    tr=db.execute("select state,reason,attempt,checkpoint,next_action,stamp,retry from transitions where task=? order by seq desc limit 1",(task_id,)).fetchone()
finally:
    db.close()

if not task:
    print("E122=TASK_ROW_MISSING",flush=True); raise SystemExit(32)
status,attempt,run=task
out={"status":status,"attempt":attempt,"run":run}
if tr:
    out.update({"transition_state":tr[0],"reason":tr[1],"transition_attempt":tr[2],"checkpoint":tr[3],"next_action":tr[4],"stamp":tr[5],"stored_retry":tr[6]})
    effective=min(float(tr[6] or 0),float(tr[5] or 0)+900) if tr[1]=="USAGE_LIMIT" else float(tr[6] or 0)
    out["effective_retry_at"]=effective
    out["remaining_seconds"]=max(0,int(effective-time.time()))
print("E122_STATE "+json.dumps(out,separators=(",",":"),default=str),flush=True)

if status=="PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT" and tr and tr[0]=="PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT" and tr[1]=="USAGE_LIMIT" and tr[4]=="resume_same_task":
    if int(attempt or 0)>=1:
        print("E122=CANONICAL_USAGE_PAUSE_OK",flush=True); raise SystemExit(0)
    print("E122=PAUSE_ATTEMPT_INVALID",flush=True); raise SystemExit(33)
if status=="COMPLETE":
    print("E122=R4_COMPLETE",flush=True); raise SystemExit(10)
if status=="RUNNING":
    print("E122=R4_RUNNING",flush=True); raise SystemExit(20)
if status=="WAITING_RETRY":
    print("E122=WAITING_RETRY_NONUSAGE",flush=True); raise SystemExit(21)
print("E122=UNEXPECTED_STATE_"+str(status),flush=True); raise SystemExit(39)
